origins: Thinking Machines Lab blog (Sep 2025): diagnoses LLM-inference nondeterminism as dynamic-batch-size variance and proposes batch-invariant kernels
arXiv 2601.17768 LLM-42 (Jan 2026): a distinct research group proposing a verify-rollback speculation mechanism for enforcing determinism
reason: The two sources address the same phenomenon (inference nondeterminism from dynamic batching plus floating-point non-associativity) but are two separate research efforts with different authors, venues, dates, and engineering approaches: s1 offers batch-invariant kernels with a measured 1.6-2x slowdown, while s2 proposes a non-deterministic fast path plus a lightweight verify-rollback loop incurring overhead only on traffic that needs determinism. This is convergent independent work, not a single primary origin re-run across hosts.
